test_title: PYST 50: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 07 Mar, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom

In the heat of the moment

options.text: Overwhelmed by what is happening in the moment

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. Overwhelmed by what is happening in the moment. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"In the heat of the moment"** means being overwhelmed by what is happening in the moment. (उस क्षण की स्थिति से अभिभूत हो जाना) • **Example: **In the heat of the moment, he said things he didn't mean. • **Overwhelmed by what is happening in the moment** refers to a state where one is so caught up in the current situation that they may act impulsively or say things without thinking. (उस क्षण की स्थिति से प्रभावित होकर अचानक प्रतिक्रिया देना) • **Example: **She apologized later, explaining that her rude comment was made in the heat of the moment. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Hurried** (जल्दबाजी): Done in a quick or rushed manner. • **Example:** In his hurried state, he forgot to lock the door. • **Under firm control, well managed** (सख्त नियंत्रण में, अच्छी तरह से प्रबंधित): Something that is being managed or controlled very effectively. • **Example: **The crisis was under firm control, thanks to the quick actions of the authorities. • **To have something secured** (कुछ सुरक्षित रखना): To have something safely in possession or guaranteed. • **Example:** He had the contract secured before the competition even knew about it. 38:T7aa, **The correct answer is option 3.**
